basic_info.description: Designed by noted architects Masten & Hurd, this 1935 St. Francis Wood home combines classic charm with everyday convenience. The traditional floor plan features 4 bedrooms and 3.5 baths, a formal living room with fireplace, formal dining room, spacious kitchen with adjoining breakfast room, and a seamless flow that's ideal for both entertaining and daily living.  Elegant details include hardwood floors, crown molding, and French-pane windows, while modern comforts such as a dedicated laundry room, ample storage, and a side-by-side two-car garage enhance functionality. A private patio opens to a beautifully landscaped terraced yard, offering easy indoor-outdoor living.  Located on a serene street near neighborhood parks, West Portal Village, and commuter routes, this home balances timeless architecture with practical convenience in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods
